title: Decide how a shared brain is declared so its page ids do not depend on where each instance mounts it
notes: Page ids carry the path from the index directory, so the same page is projects/vibra-dmx in one instance and shared/vibra/projects/vibra-dmx in another, and a [[folder/name]] link resolves in one and dangles in the next. The 2026-11-24 trial worked around it with bare [[name]] links in both the shared repository and the 21 pages of the MBP wiki that link into it, which only holds while filenames stay unique across every mounted brain.
